note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1952 in Glenarm North, Islandmagee North and Islandmagee South. When nominations closed the clerk, Mr. Wallace Nelson, had received papers for only eight of the 16 seats: five sole nominations and the three contests. In seven divisions the outgoing members, who returned no papers, were deemed re-elected (Larne Times, 22 May 1952, p. 5); each of them stands again as a retiring member in the 1955 notice. In Ballycorr the retiring member did not seek re-election and no one was nominated; the seat was filled at a separate election declared on 30 June 1952 (Samuel McCrone; Larne Times, 3 July 1952, p. 5) and is not counted in this round. No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed.
